question: Ovarian cancer is staged clinically using the FIGO 2018 system — the same system used for cervical cancer — because both are gynaecological malignancies.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Incorrect — this statement is false. Ovarian cancer uses the FIGO 2014 surgical staging system. Cervical cancer uses FIGO 2018. These are distinct systems and must not be confused. Ovarian staging is determined at staging laparotomy, not by clinical examination.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct to mark this false. Ovarian cancer is staged SURGICALLY using the FIGO 2014 classification, which is entirely separate from the FIGO 2018 system for cervical cancer. Applying the cervical staging system to ovarian cancer is a common and serious error.
